nodes.label: Seed README
nodes.rationale: How to load playable reference data into Firestore via SeedMain. No picks, no passwords, no Firebase Auth user creation.

nodes.label: SeedMain
nodes.rationale: Entry points tools/seed/seed.cmd and tools/seed/seed run SeedMain through the Maven wrapper. Loads SEC venues, teams, rivalries, the 2026 sample season, 18 themes, and an optional bootstrap manager.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Manager
nodes.rationale: When the email matches a Firebase Auth user, seed sets player and manager claims and upserts users/{uid}. If the user is missing, reference data is written and the process exits 1. Seed never creates a password user.

nodes.label: Idempotent Seed Re-run
nodes.rationale: Document ids are stable. Re-run keeps createDate and createUser, increments version, and does not delete extra documents, picks, or another season's isCurrent. No reset flag; wipe the emulator data instead.
